messages:
elaine.sre: Hey team — the post-incident writeup for the 03/18 inference degradation is live: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1845678901-serving-deg-writeup. TL;DR: cache eviction bug + a regression in batching heuristics caused a latency spike for ~28min.
elaine.sre: I pasted the RCA sections at the top and kept an action-items table at the bottom. Please skim the TL;DR + action items before EOD. :memo: 
postmortem-bot: New doc created by elaine.sre: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1845678901-serving-deg-writeup (automated snapshot) :robot_face: 
mike.platform: Thanks — quick Q: for the "batching heuristic" rollback entry, can you add the exact commit hash we reverted? makes audits easier.
elaine.sre: sure — will add the commit and short diff. commit: `a3f9d2b` (reverted), added sample `git show a3f9d2b --name-only` to appendix.
karen.prod: volunteering to own the monitoring alert tweak (increase grace window + alert threshold). I can PR the threshold change today. :+1:
samir.eng: I'll own the postmortem test that simulates high-prefix-cache-turnover. Will add a short perf test to the staging suite and link it in the doc. ETA: Wed COB.
elaine.sre: action items (copied here so it's easy to ping):
1) Add commit hash + minimal revert diff to RCA — owner: @elaine.sre — due: today EOD
2) Alert tuning: increase cache-stall window from 10s -> 25s + add runbook link — owner: @karen.prod — due: tomorrow 12:00 PT
3) Performance test: synthetic prefix-turnover scenario added to staging — owner: @samir.eng — due: Wednesday COB
4) Dedicated fallback policy: evaluate increasing fallback retries from 2 -> 4 (safety check) — owner: @mike.platform — due: Fri 9am PT
5) Customer comms review: PR draft for affected customers (outreach templates) — owner: @elaine.sre + support — due: Thu EOD
elaine.sre: Also proposing a 30-min follow-up checkpoint next week to review progress and close action items. Suggested slots: Tue 10:00 PT or Wed 16:00 PT. Please react with :thumbsup: on preferred slot or DM conflicts.
mike.platform: +1 Tue 10:00 PT works for me.
karen.prod: Wed 16:00 PT works better for me — leaning towards that.
samir.eng: Tue 10:00 would conflict with a customer sync. Wed 16:00 is better.
elaine.sre: Ok locking Wed 16:00 PT. Calendar invite will go out in a few. Agenda: quick recap (5m), status of each action item (3m each), decision on fallback retry policy (10m), next steps.
postmortem-bot: Calendar invite created: "Postmortem check-in: 03/18 inference degradation" Wed 16:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood/ev/1845678901-checkin
mike.platform: For the fallback retries decision: can we have a quick risk matrix attached to the doc? e.g., probability of increased cost vs reduced outage surface. I can draft one and drop it in the doc by Tue morning.
elaine.sre: That'd be great. Add a short table and a recommended default (optimize for fail-open with conservative retries) — I'll call out the SLO cost implications.
karen.prod: PR for alert tuning going up in ~30m. tag me for review.
samir.eng: pushed initial perf-test branch and linked in the doc under Appendix B. still needs a small data fixture, ETA Wed morning.
elaine.sre: Thanks all. I'll update the doc with commit hash + diffs and post a final "action items updated" message once all owners confirm. If anyone wants to be added to the outreach list for customers, ping support or DM me. :wave:
elaine.sre: ACTIONS UPDATED: commit hash added, appendix includes `git show`, perf-test link, alert PR link. Owners: please mark done in the doc when complete. Closing loop here — will re-open thread if blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
